text:
ops-bot: ALERT hosted-edge-usa1 - sustained 5xx rate ~50% over the last 3m, spike origin 2026-03-17T14:02:00Z. runbook: https://go/runbooks/hosted-5xx.
priya (oncall): I'm triaging. Creating war-room in #incidents. Runtime/infra please join.
maria (support): multiple customers reporting generation timeouts + unexpected billing token usage (Acme, BrightApps). They're escalated.
ben (runtime): seeing auth-proxy 502s aggregated at the gateway + kv_cache eviction warnings on model-xyz-4q nodes. sample log: 
```
2026-03-17T14:01:58Z gateway auth-proxy 502 upstream_timeout route=/v1/generate client_id=acct-123 trace=abcd1234
kv_cache: eviction_count=12 shard=4 node=gpu-04
```
claire (sre): also seeing average seq_len jump in traces -> longer decode time, batcher backlog grows, inflight requests pile up.
priya (oncall): Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) apply per-route throttling for long requests; 2) enable fallback to smaller quantized model for affected customers; 3) tighten circuit breaker for auth-proxy. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
josh (product): prefer targeted fallback (canary) for impacted accounts only, avoid global quality regression. Communicate degraded quality up-front.
ben (runtime): rolled a temporary per-account fallback to model-xyz-2q for acct-123 and acct-456 via Console (policy id: fb-2026-03-17-1). Monitoring now.
maria (support): Acme shows reduced 5xxs after fallback, BrightApps still seeing 502s. I've asked for customer logs and sample payloads.
claire (sre): I'm going to lower auth-proxy max_inflight by 25% and shorten breaker window on hosted-edge-usa1; will also validate autoscaler headroom.
priya (oncall): Action items (assign): ben - investigate kv_cache eviction root cause + reproduce; claire - circuit breaker + autoscale validation and revert plan; josh - draft customer comms for degraded fallback + status update; maria - collect repro payloads, pull billing anomalies into ticket.
ben (runtime): early suspicion: memory pressure from 4-bit quantized model (model-xyz-4q) + larger-than-usual KV cache growth when seq_len increases -> evictions. I can repro locally with load test:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://hosted.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"model-xyz-4q","prompt":"lorem"}' & done
```
maria (support): uploaded customer repros and logs to JIRA TICKET-9876 and linked to this thread.
priya (oncall): ops-bot, mute noisy non-sev1 alerts for hosted-edge-usa1; keep paging for sev1.
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Alerts muted (non-sev1) for hosted-edge-usa1. Paging remains enabled.
claire (sre): pushed circuit-breaker change and tightened timeouts; validated autoscaler didn't overshoot. Monitoring shows 5xx rate down from 52% -> 6% in 12m. Batchers still at ~85% CPU.
josh (product): sending interim status to affected customers now (degraded quality fallback + we are investigating root cause).
priya (oncall): Postmortem owners: ben (technical lead), claire (sre mitigations), josh (customer comms). Draft due by 2026-03-19 COB.
maria (support): created action list in TICKET-9876: - collect more repro payloads - validate billing delta - coordinate customer follow-ups.
priya (oncall): We'll keep monitoring for 30m after CB change, then decide on rolling fallback wider vs targeted fixes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ben (runtime): I'll prioritize a fix to reduce KV cache churn and add better metrics for eviction rates.
claire (sre): I'll add an automated alert for sudden seq_len distribution shifts + link to runbook.
priya (oncall): Closing war-room once monitoring stable for 1 hour. Leaving this thread as record.
